# Ponies
Ponies hail from the distant planet of Equestria; a world of magic with diverse life. There are known to be 4 major variants with their own minor differences. Though, across the entire race, Ponies are generally more resistant to [color=#ec3a3a]Blunt[/color] damage while being weaker to [color=#347515]Poison[/color] damage. However, due to their hooves, they cannot use most guns and instead must rely on melee or hand-to-hand combat. (hoof-to-hoof combat?)
[color=#a663f2]Unicorns[/color] are magically imbued and capable of teleportation. [color=#95e685]Earth Ponies[/color] while lacking wings or a horn, harbor powerful physical strength. [color=#63bdeb]Pegasi[/color] have thicker coats and adaptations to extreme pressure environments. [color=#ffb3fb]Alicorns[/color] have all of the above- but are exceedingly rare.
## Sorry, I'm vegetarian!
Ponies are primary fruit/vegetable/grain eaters and cannot eat meat or meat products.
## Everypony wants to rule the world...
They have their own language, formally called Equestrian due to it's global usage on their homeworld. It is very rare to find this language in non-pony societies.
